configurations.name: storage-analyzer-dev
runtimeArgs: mkdir -p build/dev && printf 'data_dir = %s/build/dev/data\npaths = %s/Projects\n' "$PWD" "$HOME" > build/dev/config && go build -o build/dev/bin/storage-analyzer ./cmd/storage-analyzer && exec build/dev/bin/storage-analyzer serve --config build/dev/config --insecure-no-auth --web web

configurations.name: storage-analyzer-dev-auth
runtimeArgs:
mkdir -p build/dev-auth && printf 'listen = 127.0.0.1:8098
data_dir = %s/build/dev-auth/data
paths = %s/Projects
' "$PWD" "$HOME" > build/dev-auth/config && go build -o build/dev/bin/storage-analyzer ./cmd/storage-analyzer && { [ -e build/dev-auth/password ] || printf 'devpassword-12
' | build/dev/bin/storage-analyzer passwd --config build/dev-auth/config; } && exec build/dev/bin/storage-analyzer serve --config build/dev-auth/config
